briefings.title: Secretary Marco Rubio: Americans Are "The Heirs" of Western Civilization
briefings.tldr: Secretary of State Marco Rubio outlined a Trump administration foreign policy anchored in "America First" nationalism, the defense of Western civilization, a strategic shift toward the Western Hemisphere, and the dismantling of the Iranian regime's conventional and nuclear ambitions.

briefings.title: Secretary Marco Rubio Joins Breitbart News

people.name: Marco Rubio
people.role: Secretary of State, U.S. Department of State

briefings.tldr: Secretary of State Marco Rubio details the Trump administration’s America First foreign policy, emphasizing the defense of Western civilization, a renewed focus on the Western Hemisphere, energy independence, and the neutralization of Iran's conventional and nuclear threats.
